explication: AWS CDK lets developers define infrastructure as reusable constructs composed into stacks and apps, then use the CDK CLI to synthesize CloudFormation templates, deploy stacks, and compare changes. The repository includes a broad construct library, including service-specific APIs, plus higher-level deployment pipelines. The graph emphasizes that documented user workflow and sampled pipeline behavior; many individual service implementations are represented by their enclosing directories. Edges cite the README or source-index references shown here, not unsampled implementation details.
